text.7:20: Then Satan whispered to them that he might manifest unto them that which was hidden from them of their shame, and he said: Your Lord forbade you from this tree only lest ye should become angels or become of the immortals.
text.20:120: But the devil whispered to him, saying: O Adam! Shall I show thee the tree of immortality and power that wasteth not away?
text.50:16: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
